explain.ko: 제1조건문은 실현 가능성이 있는 조건을 말합니다: If + 현재형, will + 동사원형. when, as soon as, until, once, before, after 같은 시간 접속사 뒤에도 미래의 일에 현재형을 씁니다(will을 쓰지 않습니다). unless는 if … not과 같고, as long as는 '~하기만 하면', in case는 '~할 경우에 대비해'입니다. 주절에는 명령문도 올 수 있습니다: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
explain.en: The first conditional talks about real, possible future conditions: If + present simple, will + base verb. After time words such as when, as soon as, until, once, before and after, use the present simple for the future (not will). Unless means if … not, as long as means 'only if', and in case means 'as a precaution'. The main clause can also be an imperative: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

rows: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
We'll be late unless we hurry.
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
You can go as long as you're careful.
Take a coat in case it gets cold.

notes.ko: if나 when 절에서는 will을 쓰지 않습니다: If it rains (not will rain).
notes.en: Do not use will in an if or when clause: If it rains (not will rain).

notes.ko: unless 뒤에는 부정문을 쓰지 않습니다: unless we hurry (not unless we don't hurry).
notes.en: Do not use a negative after unless: unless we hurry (not unless we don't hurry).

notes.ko: in case는 '그럴 경우에 대비해서'이고, if는 '그렇게 되면'입니다.
notes.en: In case means 'because it might happen'; if means 'when it does happen'.
